title.narrative: Emergency lifesaving health response to cholera outbreak in the select drought -heightened counties of Mandera, Marsabit, Turkana, Wajir, Garissa-Refugees (Dadaab) in the Kenyan northern corridor targeting affected children, women and men

description.narrative: The key objective of this project is to provide a lifesaving health response to the cholera outbreak in the select drought-heightened counties of Mandera, Marsabit, Turkana, Wajir, and Garissa-Refugees (Dadaab) in the Kenyan northern corridor targeting affected children, women, and men. This WHO project provides epidemiological surveillance and laboratory, Case management, infection Prevention and Control (IPC)/Water, Hygiene, and Sanitation (WASH), and Risk communication and community engagement. In total, the project targets 275,365 people, including 13,768 men, 55,073 women, and 206,524 children 6,196 persons with disabilities are also supported.
